_readme: Piper voices made by others, listed in the voice lab's More voices beside Piper's own (outrider/tts.py load_community).
Each is pinned to one commit of its Hugging Face repository and checked by sha256, so what downloads is what was tried.
A voice is listed only when: its licence lets anyone use it, it says what it was trained on, and that is not a
copy of a real person's or a character's voice (no celebrity, actor or game-character clones, nor voices copied from
a paid voice service). It must load and speak in Outrider's Piper. Its name is Piper's form (language_REGION-name-
quality) and must not be one of Piper's own; the files are installed under that name. docs/DESIGN_NOTES.md has the rule.

en_US-warmf-medium.about: American English, a young woman's voice. Distilled from the Kokoro-82M voice af_heart; not a copy of anyone.

en_US-mira-medium.about: American English, a woman's voice with LJSpeech's timbre, trained on speech made by ChatterBox Turbo. Its laughs and sighs need its maker's own program: here it is a plain voice.

en_AU-librivox-medium.about: Ten Australian English speakers in one voice, trained on public-domain LibriVox recordings. Piper has no Australian voice of its own.

en_US-manyvoice-medium.credit: Bryce Beattie (ManyVoice), copied to Hugging Face by AgentVibes with his blessing
en_US-manyvoice-medium.about: Sixteen speakers in one voice, twelve American and four British, trained on public-domain LibriVox recordings.
